Online exhibition of '71 war photos starts
2017-01-21T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/online-exhibition-71-war-photos-starts-1348453

Liberation War e-Archive Trust, a private organisation working for collecting historic documents of the 1971 Liberation War, yesterday opened 5,000 photos of the war for an online exhibition.

The photos representing the war scenario -- for instance, genocide by Pakistani Army and war preparation of freedom fighters -- can be seen for free at https://www.flickr.com/ photos/liberationwarbangladesh/ or on the organisation's website.

The organisers said anyone can see the photos, but cannot use those for commercial purposes.

“We organised the exhibition by following the copyright laws, and each of the photos contains its original caption and name of the photographer,” Sabbir Hossain, director of the organisation, told The Daily Star.
